title: ci(ui-merge): retire the two-repo pin gates — Spec Shape Gate, Console Pin Gate, prerelease-pin-watch
body:
Part of #25697 (item 6, PR B). PR A (#25710) carried items 1 to 5 and is merged; the card stays open for the epic PM, who hands this PR to the cutover.
Blocked-by: #25752 (cutover PR first)
Part of objectstack#25677

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this retires

Once `ui/` lives in this repository, the gates that proved the objectui pin from the outside have nothing left to prove. This PR deletes them:

- `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml` (**Spec Shape Gate**), with `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs` and `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`.
- The `console-pin` job (**Console Pin Gate**) in `ci.yml`, and the `console` list and output of its `filter` job.
- `.github/workflows/prerelease-pin-watch.yml` (**Stable release watch**).
- The `Spec Shape Gate` row of `RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS` in `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs`. The release gate now reads `CI` and `Lint & Type Check`. `release.yml` and `cut-rc.yml` have no read of their own (measured); both reach the roster only through `scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate`.

What replaces them is already on `main` from PR A: `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` compile and build the Console from `ui/` in the PR that changes one of the seven packages objectui installs (`ui_consumers` filter).

The console scripts (`build-console.sh`, `check-console-sha.mjs`, `check-console-injection.mjs`, `console-spec-probes.mjs`, `assert-console-spec-injection.mjs`) stay, as the order says. 4a #25745 deletes them with the pin.

## Tier H prose touched

- `AGENTS.md` line 533: drops `Console Pin Gate` from the list of full-battery jobs.
- `AGENTS.md` lines 1103 to 1104: the sibling-removal rule named the full battery's `Console Pin Gate` as what reds a breaking removal on `main`. It now names `Type Check UI`, which compiles the Console under `ui/` in the PR that makes the removal. Line count unchanged (1117, the ratchet ceiling).
- `docs/releases-maintenance.md`: the "What still checks the pin" paragraph is now "What used to check the pin", and the release-gate roster reads `CI`, `Lint & Type Check`.

No ADR is touched.

## Required contexts that vanish

**None.** Read at the time of this PR: the `main` ruleset requires `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, and classic branch protection requires `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Neither `Spec Shape Gate` nor `Console Pin Gate` is in either list, so the sitting needs no ruleset change for this PR. `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set` exits 0: the registry and the live set agree in both directions.

## Landing with 4a #25745

This PR and 4a are two halves of one change and land as a batch, 4a first:

- **On `main` alone this PR is red in one place.** The order keeps `check-console-injection.mjs` and `console-spec-probes.mjs` until 4a and deletes `Console Pin Gate`, their only PR-time runner. Two live-tree cases of the dispatch-gates fast tier then red: the silent load-break pair `check:console-injection` from `console-spec-probes.mjs`, and the `pull_request`-only narrowing of the scheduled-only zero. That step belongs to `Lint & Repo Gates`. With 4a merged first, the same tier passes 1917 of 1917 (verification record below). Neither case was weakened.
- **Two files overlap.** `package.json` (both PRs delete the `check:prerelease-pins` alias) and one comment in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` near line 1006. Take the `main` side (4a) in both; checked on the local merge below.

## Deviations from the order

1. `scripts/check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs` and its `check:prerelease-pins` alias are deleted here as well. Once the workflow is gone the script has no CI caller and `check-self-test-wired` reds the orphan. 4a deletes the same file, so the two deletions agree.
2. `prerelease-pin-watch.yml` does not watch the objectui pin. It watched better-auth prerelease overrides in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and its watch list was already empty. It is deleted as ordered.
3. Beyond the order's file list, these gates had to follow the deletion so they stay true: `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `check-expected-skips.mjs`, `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`. Each keeps its assertion shape; nothing is skipped or loosened.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:删掉三个只为「跨仓库钉版本」存在的门禁:Spec Shape Gate(每小时拉 objectui main 编译一遍)、Console Pin Gate(按 `.objectui-sha` 克隆 objectui 构建控制台)、prerelease-pin-watch(盯 better-auth 预发布版本,清单早已为空)。发布前的全量电池名单从三个工作流减为 `CI` 与 `Lint & Type Check`。AGENTS.md 两处、发布维护文档一处把它们改为过去时。

**为什么改**:objectui 合入 `ui/` 之后,控制台在同一个 PR 里由 `Type Check UI`、`Build & E2E UI` 编译构建,规格一改就当场验证,不再需要隔一小时去克隆另一个仓库。留着旧门禁只会对着已不存在的钉版本报错。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:不影响必需检查(这三个都不在必需集合里)。必须在 4a #25745 之后合入:单独合入时 `Lint & Repo Gates` 会因控制台脚本失去 PR 期运行者而红两条,4a 删除这些脚本后即消失。回滚就是还原此 PR,三个工作流与脚本原样恢复。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:切换当天在 4a 之后合入本 PR(Tier H,需你批准)。规则集无需改动。
